data.acceptance:
1. `thimble exec <app> <env> -- <cmd> [args...]` decrypts the full namespace and forks the child.
2. Default flavor: dotenv-encoded body delivered via the child's stdin; no filesystem write.
3. `--env` flavor: full namespace populates the child's env block; no filesystem write; no stdin write.
4. K-24 shell-guard logic reused — sh/bash/zsh/etc and docker/podman without proper scoping are refused unless --allow-shell-env.
5. Audit log records the exec event with the operator thumbprint (no values).
6. README "Consuming Secrets" section covers stdin and env flavors with Go/Python/Node/Ruby code, plus an honest trade-off table.
7. Tests cover: stdin delivery, env delivery, shell-guard refusal, child exit code propagation, no secret in argv.
8. Integration test exercises the real `age` binary end-to-end.
